name: Setting Sail
description: Every pirate starts somewhere. Learn your way around the ship, catch your first treasures, and pick a Straw Hat to sail with.
notes: The tutorial: open to everyone, permanent, and every quest is doable on the very first day. It starts in the past on purpose, so it is running the moment it is published. To turn it into the beginners-only pass instead, add the access block documented in the README.
final_message: Your crew is waiting. Pick the Straw Hat who sails with you! ⛵

tiers.name: Weighing Anchor
tiers.description: Find your way around the ship. Every quest here is a command you will use every day.

quests.name: Roll Call
quests.description: See who you are with /player info.

quests.name: Counting the Haul
quests.description: Count what you own with /treasures count.

quests.name: Checking the Purse
quests.description: Look at your berries with /berry balance.

tiers.name: First Catch
tiers.description: Treasures appear in the chat on their own. Be the first to name one and it is yours.

quests.name: Fresh Off the Deck
quests.description: Look at your latest catch with /treasures last.

quests.name: Know Your Crew
quests.description: Open a collection page with /treasures collection.

tiers.name: Berries and Barrels
tiers.description: Berries buy packs, packs hold treasures. Here is how the money moves.

quests.name: Daily Bread
quests.description: Claim your daily berries with /berry daily. Come back every day for more.

quests.name: Window Shopping
quests.description: Browse the pack shop with /pack shop.

quests.name: Free Delivery
quests.description: Claim your free daily pack with /pack daily.

quests.name: First Purchase
quests.description: Buy your first pack, any pack.

quests.name: Buggy's Counter
quests.description: Take a look at Buggy's shop with /auction shop.

tiers.name: A Crew of Your Own
tiers.description: No pirate sails alone. Meet the rest of the crew and finish the tutorial.

quests.name: Nakama
quests.description: Add your first friend with /player friend add.

quests.name: Fair Trade
quests.description: Complete your first trade with another player.

quests.name: Sharing the Loot
quests.description: Give a treasure to another player.

quests.name: Old Hand
quests.description: Catch 50 treasures in total. You know the ropes now.
